attackers_goals: Adversaries may rely on a user running a malicious image to facilitate execution.
description: The agent has pulled a docker image from a repository for the first time.
investigative_actions: Scan the docker image that was pulled. Check the repository designation. Check on which other agents the docker image is being used.
name: Suspicious docker image download from an unusual repository

variations.name: Suspicious docker image download from an unrecognized registry
variations.description: The agent has pulled a docker image from a registry that has never been used in the organization.
